misprints.note: Printed with acute on ά (πολυπράγμο-νεῖν) as well as the circumflex; double accent kept.
Strip 0142_01 (Förvilda) has it clearly printed. It is a rare form, not a misprint.

uncertain.note: Breathing mark is ambiguous at this resolution. Its shape differs from the smooth breathing on ἀπο- just below, so I read it as rough. The same applies to ἁλίσκεσθαι, ἁψίκορος and ἁψικορία in 0142_05.
The endings show only a circumflex and no breathing. I transcribed them as printed (the OCR had ὦσα, ὤν).
The f of 'af' is broken type and looks like 'aï'. I read it as 'af'.
The line wraps across the band boundary, and the accents sit at the bottom of the band above. I read them as ἐργασία, ἡ.
